title: Café site: menu data + rendering (menu.json → DOM)
desc: Child of the café epic. Deliverable: projects/cafe-site/menu.json (schema documented in the README: name, price, description, tags) and app.js which fetches it and renders the list into #menu. ACCEPTANCE: zero hardcoded menu entries in HTML; prices rendered from data; at least 8 realistic items with 2+ tags each; if fetch fails (file:// restrictions) the page still shows a clear message, not a blank section; node --check app.js passes; a tiny node test or python check proving the JSON parses and every item has the 4 fields. Interface contract with the structure child: post it on the bus in one message before you code.
